title: Barnum and Bailey, bugle calls, and birth and death dates
summary: Five years with Barnum and Bailey, blowing bugle at races and taps in Milwaukee; she corrects birth and death dates.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: You see, evidently, when he, after he'd learned to read music was when he began playing with these bands. But there was a big band, all the way through the band. The band, well he didn't have a band. You don't have anything of him when he was with Barnum and Bailey, huh? No, no. Well he was with them five years. He traveled with them all that time. Five years, yeah. He traveled all that time. And that's what I wanted to tell you. My mother told me he used to play for the races. Oh yeah, he played in the band, but he was the one that would blow the bugle. Oh, the bugle.
I like to have it at the fairground. I still have it at the fairground. He'd be the one that blew the bugle. Yes.

I remember that. I forgot to tell you that. Oh yeah. And he used to blow tap for the veteran, huh? He was in the band too, but he was the one that blew tap. In Milwaukee. In Milwaukee. In Milwaukee. He was in two veterans fans.
I wonder if we have asked yet where and when he was born, his age and so on. We got that. I think we got that information Sunday, yes.
I told him about his birthday. In fact, he's this month. You want to say for this month. That's right. He would be 78 years old.
That's Wednesday, a week from the day. Mm-hmm.
And I think I made an error on the date of his death. I told you the 23rd, but it was the 22nd of November.
